title: Zesty Bean Tacos
description: A flavorful and healthy Mexican-inspired dish featuring zesty bean sprouts and crunchy tacos.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tsp of oil and cook the mung bean sprouts for 2-3 minutes.
Add the black beans, zesty taco seasoning, and 1 cup of water to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and sliced avocado (if using).
